description: This PHP source file defines the 'Report' entity class for use with Doctrine ORM in the OrangeHRM system. It maps to the 'ohrm_report' database table and includes properties such as id, name, report group, filter usage, and type, along with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: An entity class representing a report, mapping to the 'ohrm_report' table in the database, with properties like 'id', 'name', 'reportGroup', 'useFilterField', and 'type'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the report.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the report.

methods.name: isUseFilterField
methods.description: Returns whether the report uses filter fields.

methods.name: setUseFilterField
methods.description: Sets whether the report uses filter fields.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the report, if specified.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the report.
